topics.title: Make workflow run history authoritative in Desktop

entries.title: Make workflow run history authoritative in Desktop
entries.rationale: Accepted as a security-sensitive workflow read-model change, but queued because it adds authenticated HTTP reads, channel authorization, keyset pagination, and migration state that must be reconciled with Zion’s relay contract before implementation.
security_reasons: NIP-98 authentication and replay protection on new workflow read endpoints
channel-scoped authorization for workflow history and approvals
database migration/backfill for stable error codes
approval actions must remain unavailable for non-actionable stored hashes

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after dedicated endpoint threat review, migration review, authorization tests, dependency/egress screening, Zion compatibility checks, and relay/desktop gates.

verification: Full-SHA diff, changed tests, migration, endpoint authorization flow, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; upstream explicitly leaves relay-backed workflow acceptance as follow-up; no source implementation made.
